description: A tall stack of large colorful plastic blocks sits on the bed in front of a pink pillow and wall. The left hand reaches in from the left to pinch and lift the top blue block off the tower while the right hand steadies the stack, then the right hand removes the purple block and sets it to the right as the remaining blocks wobble and begin to topple; both hands then pull blocks apart and spread them out on the bed, releasing them into a loose row.
